params.body:
After #46 the home hero shows the intro as paragraphs and a list. That made it 798px tall: on a 1440x900 screen the category bar fell below the fold, and on 1366x768 the buttons did.

From `lg` on:
- The vertical padding is 48px instead of 112px.
- The service list runs on in a row, so it takes two lines instead of four. `partials/text` takes a `$list` class for that.

Result:
- The hero is 610px tall. On 1440x900 the category bar ends at about 891px on staging, so it fits without scrolling.
- Phones keep the stacked list.
- All hero text still reaches AAA at 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920px.

Full suite: 85 tests green.
params.title: Home hero: compact on desktop so it fits a 1440x900 screen
